name: Rus 2TC Kremlin - Based on Beasty
author: TyrusLunarspear

notes: Queue up @unit_worker/villager.webp@
Send 5 @unit_worker/villager.png@ to gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.png@  from a @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ then send them to @resource/sheep.png@
Send 1 @unit_worker/villager.png@ to the woodline and build @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@ then @building_economy/house.png@ then goes to @resource/sheep.png@
@resource/rally.png@ to woodline
First @unit_worker/villager.webp@ that pops out builds another @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@ covering different trees then goes to @resource/sheep.png@
Remember to send 5 @resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/sheep.png@
@resource/rally.png@ to @resource/sheep.png@
Queue up a @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ when first @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@ finishes
Rally onto @resource/sheep.png@ until age-up
Rally to the chopped @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ until 3 on @resource/resource_wood.png@

4 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ go to build @landmark_rus/kremlin.png@, try to build it close to @resource/deer.png@ and @resource/resource_wood.png@, if you can push the deer to it. If you can't, you can place it on the @resource/resource_stone.png@
3 @resource/resource_food.png@ go to gather @resource/resource_stone.png@, build a @building_economy/mining-camp.png@

3 @resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ go to @resource/resource_stone.png@ after they finish gathering, also build a @building_economy/house.png@
@resource/rally.png@ to @resource/resource_stone.png@ until you have 8 on stone
At this point you should start pushing the @resource/deer.webp@ if you can with 3 @unit_cavalry/scout.png@
@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@
Age up @unit_worker/villager.webp@ go to @resource/resource_wood.png@ near Kremlin, build a @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@
Also kill the @resource/deer.png@ with @unit_cavalry/scout.png@
You should have enough @resource/resource_stone.webp@ (350), re-macro to @resource/resource_wood.png@ until you have 400
You should have enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to build a @building_economy/town-center.png@ on @resource/deer.png@ with 8 @unit_worker/villager.png@
@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@ until 3

description:
Now that pro scouts is nerfed, 2TC Kremlin is back to being more relevant.

However, this is probably not worth doing on any map that isn't Enlightened Horizons, and you shouldn't place Rus on Enlightened Horizons to begin with

The build order here is taken from the Beasty video I've linked
